# FERS Annuity Calculator with Sick Leave &amp; Survivor Election — Free Estimate Tool

> Free FERS annuity calculator that credits unused sick leave using OPM's official Chart 2 (not a ÷174 shortcut), applies the MRA+10 reduction by exact full months, and prices the survivor election. Estimate only — with formulas, sources, and worked examples shown.
